user_saw: In `openclaw plugins list`, a long plugin name could wrap onto a second line even when the terminal had room for it.
summary: The table renderer now sizes columns using the widest visible line in each header and cell.
reasoning: The oldest available table code already rendered explicit line breaks while measuring each cell with a single whole-string `visibleWidth` call. The later row-reduction refactor kept that calculation, and the plugin error-display change kept the existing multiline source-and-description layout. The offline path history stopped at a missing object before the July graft, so I could not verify when multiline sizing first became incorrect.
